focal_entities.receiver: the maintainer of rn, who changes these hooks and runs their tests, and the conductor, whose turn they keep on course

goal_orientation.use: to keep the conductor on its course while the user is away: waiting for every agent, ending its turn only with something for the user, speaking in the language the user chose, and reading the record again after a compact

goal_orientation.acceptance: every test passes and holds a sentence of the content; every stop names the moment, what went wrong and why; nothing is stopped where no session is open; the checks are functions of values and their tests run in milliseconds; the first two units' checks still run as before

constraints.rule: Python 3.9 with the standard library only. Run the tests with python3 -m unittest discover -s dev/rn/tests where the work is made, and see each fail before its code is written. record.py, hooks.json and the entry files are made again here: they keep everything the first two units' checks and tests rest on.
